selection.algorithm: SHA256 stable item id ascending, first N per quality track and Copydays query; retain every gallery original

use_native_official_splits.albumbench: retain train/test album assignments; no prediction or metric until query-conditioned predictor and images available
use_native_official_splits.koniq: no training or threshold fitting; declared diagnostic subset, not official test leaderboard
use_native_official_splits.kadid: no training or threshold fitting; reference family preserved as group; not official test leaderboard
use_native_official_splits.copydays: all available strong queries against all original gallery, no distractors; not full Copydays suite

predictors.quality: existing AsyncLocalClient heuristic, mean VISION_DIMS; no learned models or target calibration
predictors.copy: 64-bit pHash nearest gallery by Hamming distance; lexicographic gallery id resolves ties

quality: SROCC with average ranks for ties
metrics.aggregation: disaggregated tracks only; no cross-task scalar

interpretation: Preference, MOS/DMOS and copy correspondences are not directed semantic coverage labels. This run cannot pass G1/G2 or authorize production promotion. Labels were available for schema inspection; this is a frozen diagnostic, not a blinded independent test.
